name: vwap_zscore_mean_reversion
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, hundreds of concurrent institutional VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (mutual funds, FIIs, prop desks) compete to fill directional orders throughout the mid-session. When a large block or cascade of market orders temporarily drives NIFTY 2.5+ standard deviations away from session VWAP in a non-directional (low directional-efficiency) regime, these VWAP algos collectively accelerate in the opposite direction — each algo is getting fills significantly better than its VWAP benchmark and increases participation rate. The resulting institutional counter-flow produces a mean-reversion snap-back of 10-20 NIFTY spot points within 30-90 seconds. The ADX/directional-efficiency filter is critical: on trending days NIFTY can sustain 3-sigma VWAP deviations for hours, so we only trade when the session character is choppy (directional efficiency < 0.30).

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure from session open — no scaling needed. Session VWAP is the institutional benchmark that NIFTY-algo desks are evaluated against throughout the day.

indicators.name: vwap_z
indicators.purpose: 120 bars = 10 minutes rolling std. At 5s resolution, 10 minutes captures the current intraday volatility regime without including stale AM volatility. The original used 20 one-minute bars (20 min) as the normalization window. We compress to 10 min because we're trading the fast snap-back (30-90s), not the slow drift back over 15-45 minutes, so we want a more responsive local vol estimate that reflects the current session moment.

indicators.name: directional_efficiency_60
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5 minutes directional efficiency. Replaces ADX(14) from original. For a context filter on a 5-second strategy, we need something that reacts within 5 minutes to a trending shift — ADX(14 min) is too slow for a 30-90s hold. Directional efficiency (net move / total path length) over 60 bars directly measures whether the last 5 minutes has been directional (>0.4) or choppy (<0.25). Value < 0.30 is the analog of ADX < 20, matching the original's non-trending filter.

conditions: close > open (bullish reversal bar — price starting to recover)
buy_ce.confirmation: Bullish 5s candle (close > open) at the z-score extreme confirms first buyers are stepping in

conditions: close < open (bearish reversal bar — first sellers appearing)
buy_pe.confirmation: Bearish 5s candle at the z-score extreme confirms selling pressure emerging at overextension

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). A 2.5-sigma VWAP deviation on NIFTY typically represents 12-20 spot points below VWAP. If price moves another 8 spot points further from VWAP (deepening deviation), the mean-reversion thesis is broken — the market may have transitioned to trending mode mid-trade. 4 option pts gives room for one further 5s bar of extension without being overly tight.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). A 2.5-sigma VWAP deviation reverts to VWAP over 30-90 seconds, covering ~80% of the deviation distance. The deviation itself is typically 15-25 spot points on NIFTY; 14 spot pts (7 option pts) captures 60-70% of the expected snap-back — conservative enough to be hit within the 90s time window, giving 1:1.75 risk-reward.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST (session end, avoid late-day trend transitions)

filters.vix_filter: vix < 20.0 — VIX > 20 means elevated vol where 3-sigma deviations can persist; reversion is unreliable in fear regimes
filters.time_filter: 10:00-14:30 IST (600-870 min) — avoids opening auction noise (09:15-10:00) and late-session trend-following dominance (14:30+)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is always liquid; individual bar volume not meaningful at 5s on index
filters.trend_filter: directional_efficiency_60 < 0.30 — non-trending regime required, analogous to ADX < 20 in original
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral; as more algos discover VWAP reversion the snap-back speed increases but the edge persists because institutional VWAP benchmarking is structural

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Universe shifted from nifty200 stocks to NIFTY index — the index has structural VWAP-algo flow that individual stocks lack, making the mechanism MORE reliable, not less; (2) z-score threshold relaxed from 3.0 to 2.5 because 5-second NIFTY bars are less noisy than individual stock 1-minute bars — a 2.5-sigma event on 5s bars is still genuinely extreme; (3) ADX(14 min) replaced by directional_efficiency over 60 bars (5 min) — more responsive to regime changes within the compressed hold window, directly measures choppiness without the smoothing lag of Wilder ADX.
weaknesses: NIFTY trending days: directional_efficiency filter should block entries, but rapid trend accelerations can temporarily register as non-trending before reversing
Flash-crash scenarios: VIX can lag a sudden NIFTY crash by 1-2 minutes; VIX filter may not protect in time
Expiry days: large gamma unwinds can cause sustained VWAP deviations that don't revert — consider skipping NIFTY weekly expiry Thursday
